summary: Man accessing his storage unit at E. 2nd St and Plum St in Leadville fell 30 ft into an ice- and water-filled sinkhole; firefighter Alex Conlin rappelled 30 ft to reach him and Lake County SAR performed the high-angle extraction; the badly injured subject was airlifted by helicopter to a Denver-area hospital after a ~90-minute rescue
location: Self-storage facility, E. 2nd St and Plum St, Leadville
responding_agency: Leadville/Lake County Fire Rescue, Lake County SAR, Leadville Police, St. Vincent Ambulance
notes: Dispatched ~6:02pm April 1, 2021 per Leadville/Lake County Fire Rescue Facebook post quoted in retro1025.com (April 1, 2021 was a Thursday); one secondary report said Saturday but the fire department dispatch record pins Thursday April 1
